title: Plan safety testing and certification, such as UKCA or CE marking and radio rules
summary: Physical products must meet safety and conformity rules before they can be sold. Find out which rules apply early, because testing takes time and failures mean redesigns.

beginner: List the markets you will sell in, such as Great Britain, Northern Ireland or the EU.
Ask a compliance specialist which rules apply, such as electrical safety, radio and electromagnetic compatibility.
Find out which tests you can self-declare and which need an approved test body.
Book test slots early and put them on the roadmap.
Keep the technical file: test reports, design documents and risk assessments.
intermediate: Map the rules for each market and plan one test campaign that covers them.
Run pre-compliance tests on early builds to avoid late surprises.
Agree who signs the declaration of conformity.
experienced: Set a compliance roadmap across products and markets.
Track rule changes that affect future products.
Budget for re-testing when designs change.

canDelegateTo.task: Confirm which rules apply in each market

toolExamples.confluence: Keep the technical file index on one page.
toolExamples.jira: Track each certification as an item with a due date.

definitionOfDone: Rules listed for every target market
pitfalls: Finding out about radio rules after the design is fixed
Forgetting Northern Ireland has different marking rules
